🆕 Newly posted (Published: September 24, 2026)

Saitama Prefecture is running an emergency support program to help agricultural, forestry, and fisheries businesses cope with sudden price spikes and supply shortages of petroleum-derived products due to the Middle East situation. The program will cover part of the increased input costs or the price difference for replacement products.

An information session will be held.

【Date and time】Wednesday, September 30, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM

【Format】Web session via Microsoft Teams

【Registration】No registration required. Join from the URL below on the day: https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/429011343164186?p=fpvChVdzp38ThLPgCn
ID: 429 011 343 164 186 / Passcode: 7ka73Bf7

【Session materials】Scheduled to be posted on the Saitama Prefecture Production Promotion Division website by Tuesday, September 29, 2026

If web viewing is difficult, you can watch at the same time at the satellite venue in the conference room on the 2nd floor of JAiruma-no Broad-area Farm Operation Center (1805-126 Shimoacasaka, Kawagoe).

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kankyokeizaibu/nogyoshinkoka/tyojutaisaku/14439.html
summary: ℹ️ Emergency support for rising input costs due to Middle East situation (agricultural, forestry, and fisheries businesses)
